abstract.p: The present invention relates to a system for facilitating treatment via a vascular wall defining a vascular true lumen (116) containing an occlusion (120) therein, the system comprising:an intramural orienting device (3400) including an outer shaft (3410) connected to a proximal end (3446) of an orienting element (3440), and an inner shaft (3420) extending through the outer shaft (3410) and the orienting element (3440), wherein a distal end of the inner shaft (3420) is connected to a distal end (3448) of the orienting element (3440);wherein the inner shaft (3420) includes a lumen extending therethrough to a side port (3425) adjacent the orienting element (3440);wherein the orienting element (3440) comprises a metallic tube with cuts made to define two wings (3442A, 3442B), wherein contracting the proximal end (3446) of the orienting element (3440) toward the distal end (3448) of the orienting element (3440) extends the wings (3442A, 3442B) outwardly in a substantially planar manner.
